split_algorithm: each fixture is one group, so all of its criteria share a split; for each kind in sorted order, sort fixture ids and shuffle with one random.Random(seed); concatenate; assign alternately dev, test starting with dev

metrics.false_supported: pairs shown supported whose gold is contradicted or insufficient_evidence, over all non-supported gold pairs; Wilson 95% interval
metrics.contradicted_recall: pairs shown contradicted over gold contradicted pairs; Wilson 95% interval
metrics.abstention_rate: pairs shown abstained or no_answer, or whose call failed, over all scored pairs
metrics.ambiguity: pairs flagged ambiguous; excluded from every rate and listed separately
metrics.brier: mean (P(supported) - [gold == supported])^2 over scored pairs with probabilities
metrics.latency: p50 and p95 latency_ms over answered receipts
metrics.cost: total and mean observed cost_usd over receipts

threshold_policy.locked: decision_review.THRESHOLD at the locked run, recorded in reports/review-test.json

release_bar.basis: point estimate on the locked split
